      "source": [
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "\n",
        "df = pd.read_csv(\"/content/GSE151580_rawCountTable.csv.gz\")\n",
        "print(df.shape)\n",
        "df.head()\n",
        "\n",
        "genes = {\n",
        "    \"PHGDH\" : \"ENSG00000092621\" ,\n",
        "    \"PSAT1\" : \"ENSG00000135069\" ,\n",
        "    \"PSPH\" : \"ENSG00000146733\"\n",
        "}\n",
        "for name , code in genes.items():\n",
        "  found = df[df[\"geneID\"].str.startswith(code)]\n",
        "  print(name, code, \"rows found:\" , len, (found))"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "counts = df.set_index(\"geneID\")\n",
        "cpm = counts / counts.sum() * 1_000_000\n",
        "logcpm = np.log2(cpm + 1)\n",
        "\n",
        "genes = {\n",
        "    \"PHGDH\" : \"ENSG00000092621\" ,\n",
        "    \"PSAT1\" : \"ENSG00000135069\" ,\n",
        "    \"PSPH\" : \"ENSG00000146733\"\n",
        "}\n",
        "small = logcpm.loc[list(genes.values())]\n",
        "small.index = list(genes.keys())\n",
        "print(small.T.round(2))"
      ],
      "metadata": {

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "from scipy.stats import wilcoxon\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "\n",
        "hm_ids = {c[:-2] for c in small.columns if c.endswith(\"HM\")}\n",
        "pt_ids = {c[:-2] for c in small.columns if c.endswith(\"PT\")}\n",
        "patients = sorted(hm_ids & pt_ids)\n",
        "print(len(patients), \"patients with both samples\")\n",
        "\n",
        "fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(11, 4))\n",
        "for ax, gene in zip(axes, small.index):\n",
        "    pt = small.loc[gene, [p + \"PT\" for p in patients]].values\n",
        "    hm = small.loc[gene, [p + \"HM\" for p in patients]].values\n",
        "    stat, pval = wilcoxon(hm, pt)\n",
        "    print(gene, \"| liver higher in\", int((hm > pt).sum()), \"of\", len(patients),\n",
        "          \"| median change:\", round(float(np.median(hm - pt)), 2),\n",
        "          \"| p =\", round(float(pval), 4))\n",
        "    for a, b in zip(pt, hm):\n",
        "        ax.plot([0, 1], [a, b], color=\"gray\", marker=\"o\")\n",
        "    ax.set_xticks([0, 1])\n",
        "    ax.set_xticklabels([\"Primary\", \"Liver met\"])\n",
        "    ax.set_title(gene)\n",
        "    ax.set_ylabel(\"log2 CPM\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests\n",
        "\n",
        "genes_list = [\"PHGDH\", \"PSAT1\", \"PSPH\"]\n",
        "pvals = [0.6355, 0.0479, 0.0134]\n",
        "reject, adjusted, _, _ = multipletests(pvals, method=\"bonferroni\")\n",
        "\n",
        "for g, p, a in zip(genes_list, pvals, adjusted):\n",
        "    print(g, \"| original p =\", p, \"| corrected p =\", round(a, 3))\n",
        ""
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"

            "PHGDH | original p = 0.6355 | corrected p = 1.0\n",

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "from scipy.stats import wilcoxon\n",
        "from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests\n",
        "from google.colab import files\n",
        "\n",
        "hm_ids = {c[:-2] for c in small.columns if c.endswith(\"HM\")}\n",
        "pt_ids = {c[:-2] for c in small.columns if c.endswith(\"PT\")}\n",
        "patients = sorted(hm_ids & pt_ids)\n",
        "\n",
        "rows = []\n",
        "fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(11, 4))\n",
        "for ax, gene in zip(axes, small.index):\n",
        "    pt = small.loc[gene, [p + \"PT\" for p in patients]].values\n",
        "    hm = small.loc[gene, [p + \"HM\" for p in patients]].values\n",
        "    stat, pval = wilcoxon(hm, pt)\n",
        "    rows.append({\n",
        "        \"gene\": gene,\n",
        "        \"n_pairs\": len(patients),\n",
        "        \"liver_higher_in\": int((hm > pt).sum()),\n",
        "        \"median_change\": float(np.median(hm - pt)),\n",
        "        \"p_value\": pval,\n",
        "    })\n",
        "    for a, b in zip(pt, hm):\n",
        "        ax.plot([0, 1], [a, b], color=\"gray\", marker=\"o\")\n",
        "    ax.set_xticks([0, 1])\n",
        "    ax.set_xticklabels([\"Primary\", \"Liver met\"])\n",
        "    ax.set_title(gene)\n",
        "    ax.set_ylabel(\"log2 CPM\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.savefig(\"serine_paired_plot.png\", dpi=200)\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "results = pd.DataFrame(rows)\n",
        "results[\"p_corrected\"] = multipletests(results[\"p_value\"], method=\"bonferroni\")[1]\n",
        "results = results.round(4)\n",
        "results.to_csv(\"serine_results.csv\", index=False)\n",
        "print(results)\n",
        "\n",
        "files.download(\"serine_paired_plot.png\")\n",
        "files.download(\"serine_results.csv\")\n"
      ],

        "n_ids = sorted({c[:-1] for c in small.columns if c.endswith(\"N\") and not c.endswith(\"HM\")})\n",
        "n_ids = [p for p in n_ids if p + \"PT\" in small.columns and p + \"HM\" in small.columns]\n",
        "print(len(n_ids), \"patients with Normal, Primary and Liver met:\", n_ids)\n",
        "\n",
        "fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(11, 4))\n",
        "for ax, gene in zip(axes, small.index):\n",
        "    for p in n_ids:\n",
        "        vals = [small.loc[gene, p + \"N\"], small.loc[gene, p + \"PT\"], small.loc[gene, p + \"HM\"]]\n",
        "        ax.plot([0, 1, 2], vals, color=\"gray\", marker=\"o\")\n",
        "    ax.set_xticks([0, 1, 2])\n",
        "    ax.set_xticklabels([\"Normal\\npancreas\", \"Primary\", \"Liver met\"])\n",
